name: Reincarnated Into Harem Game
source:
After clearing your favorite harem game 100 times, you wake as its legendary sorcerer, Aldren, with perfect route knowledge and disastrously unreliable magic. From Aldren's Castle, you must capture the attention and win the willing allegiance of seven demon brides before their wedding ritual ends the world. But your quietly possessive maid knows more than she admits, and saving these women means abandoning the walkthrough that taught you how to win them.

[From [url=https://pomomi.com/series/reincarnated-into-harem-game]the official website[/url]]
